verdict.rationale: Running a GPU headlessly or in CI is a fair axis for this product, since a buyer could reasonably ask whether the card runs unattended in servers or CI runners. The pack never documents headless operation or CI use of the RTX PRO 6000 itself. The nearest items are ecosystem building blocks: CUDA Toolkit deployment targets and NGC containers or Helm charts. Those are developer and host-platform primitives, not the product's own documented capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
